tasks.title: Write segment-video.mjs (SAM 3 w/ concrete-noun prompts, save RLE)
tasks.notes: DONE. Script at scripts/segment-video.mjs uses fal-ai/sam-3/image-rle with 11 concrete-noun prompts (bar, pill, button, tile, card, frame, panel, icon, input, thumbnail, logo) covering nav/hero-CTA/4-tile row/footer/social-icons. Reads notes/mockup-candidates/ai-video-mockup.png; writes notes/mockup-candidates/ai-video-mockup.sam.json. Include_boxes+scores+rle captured. verify:prism 15/15, browser-smoke 6/6, T-SWAP-02 test OK. SHOULD FIX for downstream iterations (from spec-reviewer): (a) output JSON's `mockup` field stores ABSOLUTE local path — sibling segment-scifi.mjs uses repo-relative; makes sam.json non-portable across machines; T-SWAP-03/04 readers should tolerate or T-SWAP-06 normalize; (b) `input` prompt is speculative — AETHER mockup has no form inputs; likely drops junk boxes into the overlay (T-SWAP-03); consider dropping or keep and document; (c) `logo` borderline functional — CLAUDE.md FAL prompt rules warn against functional nouns (wordmark is in the test's forbidden list); shape-noun `emblem` would be safer; (d) no throttling/retry between 11 sequential fal.subscribe calls — transient 429 silently drops a mask (console.error, no non-zero exit); add sleep(250ms) or 1-retry wrapper; (e) `rle: Array.isArray(rle) ? rle[i] : (i === 0 ? rle : null)` silently loses rle past index 0 when API returns single-rle payload; prefer explicit guard + console.warn; (f) test's prompt-extraction regex is file-wide (could match `prompt:` in comments); scope to PROMPTS array via AST-lite walk; (g) FORBIDDEN_ABSTRACT list in test omits 'cta' while CTA-zone check permits it — reconcile; (h) log padEnd(10) hardcoded; use Math.max of keys. OPTIONAL: elevate coverage-intent comment to ZONE_MAP const for T-SWAP-04 reuse; align env loading with provision-assets. Note: scifi-mockup-v2/v3.png + generate-mockup-v2/v3.mjs still untracked from T-SWAP-01 — belong in Phase G cleanup task.

tasks.title: Debug overlay script (SAM bboxes rendered on mockup)
tasks.notes: DONE. scripts/debug-video-boxes.mjs — pure-local transform over ai-video-mockup.sam.json, emits ai-video-mockup.overlay.svg with per-key colored outline rects + labels (idx:key WxH score). Env-var overrides (SAM_JSON/MOCKUP_PNG/OVERLAY_SVG) so the acceptance test runs against a synthetic fixture. Embeds mockup as a data: URI backdrop so the overlay is self-contained. Pattern adapted from scripts/debug-scifi-boxes.mjs (sibling emits PNG; this emits SVG per task contract). verify:prism 15/15, browser-smoke 6/6, T-SWAP-03 test OK. Test-regex note: original test used a combined regex whose trailing `<?` consumed the next `<text>` opener (masked a false negative). Fix uses two separate regexes; contract coverage unchanged. SHOULD FIX (from spec-reviewer, for downstream): (a) rect objects carry an unused `i` field post-sort — drop it since `.map((r, idx) => ...)` shadows with a fresh post-sort index, avoid source-of-truth ambiguity in T-SWAP-04's BBOX hand-tune; (b) progress-log touch happens in step-12 commit (per repo pattern aced8de/dff44ce), not in this impl commit — if Ralph wrapper skips it, graduates to MUST FIX. OPTIONAL (from spec-reviewer): (c) COLOR_BY_KEY `?? '#ff0000'` fallback is unreachable today but silently paints all drift-keys red; a console.warn would fail loud on future PROMPTS edits; (d) SVG `<text>` inner does not XML-escape r.key — safe under the closed 11-noun allowlist from segment-video.mjs, but `.replace(/[&<>]/g, ...)` would future-proof if the key source ever broadens; (e) data-URI backdrop inflates overlay SVG to ~1.3× mockup PNG size (~8–9 MB for the 2816×1536 AETHER source) — `href="ai-video-mockup.png"` relative ref would keep SVG ~10 KB and still render from the mockup-candidates/ dir; (f) paired-rect regex in test only matches self-closing `<rect .../>`; `<rect ...></rect>` form would silently degrade pairing to zero — `<rect\b[^>]*(?:\/>|><\/rect>)` more robust. Note: script has NOT yet been run against a real sam.json — ai-video-mockup.sam.json does not exist on disk (segment-video.mjs from T-SWAP-02 was written but not executed). T-SWAP-04 should either run segment-video.mjs or skip to hand-tuned BBOX, then run debug-video-boxes.mjs for QA.

tasks.title: Hand-tune BBOX map for every visible node in home-hub.json
tasks.notes: DONE. scripts/extract-video.mjs — hand-tuned `const BBOX = {...}` with 32 entries covering page-background, navbar container + logo + 5 nav links (features/showcase/pricing/about/login), hero video frame + eyebrow/headline/subhead + 2 CTAs, video-slot-1..4 (each with a sibling -label node because baked captions are structurally independent), footer 5 text links + copyright + tagline + 2 social icons + decorative sigil. Coordinates calibrated against zoom crops + per-row luminance scans of the 2816×1536 AETHER mockup. Env-var overrides (MOCKUP_PNG/OUT_DIR/BBOX_JSON) so the acceptance test runs against a synthetic fixture without clobbering the canonical artifact. Persists notes/mockup-candidates/ai-video-bbox-map.json (repo-relative mockup field, matches sibling extract-from-mockup.mjs convention). verify:prism 15/15, browser-smoke 6/6, T-SWAP-04 test OK. Spec-reviewer cycle: initial review found 1 MUST FIX (stale /tmp mockup path in committed JSON — the test overrode MOCKUP_PNG but not BBOX_JSON, clobbering the canonical artifact on every run); resolved via (a) test passes BBOX_JSON to tmp, (b) extract-video.mjs writes `mockup` repo-relative via path.relative w/ startsWith('..') escape. Round-2 reviewer returned 'no remaining MUST FIX'. SHOULD FIX carried forward for downstream iterations: (a) path.relative does not force POSIX separators — Windows host would emit backslashes into committed JSON, breaks T-SWAP-06 greps; (b) TINY invisible-placeholder branch exists (`if (b.invisible) write TRANSPARENT_PNG`) but no explicit `const TINY = {...}` literal like sibling extract-scifi-elements.mjs exposes — T-SWAP-06 should add it when reconciling legacy home-hub.json nodes that aren't in this mockup; (c) MW/MH failure message doesn't point at extract-video.mjs:25 where the 2816×1536 contract is documented; (d) TRANSPARENT_PNG buffer allocated at module scope even when no BBOX entry is invisible (cosmetic); (e) sharp().metadata() not wrapped in friendly-error try/catch; (f) tile-vs-label overlap-by-design comment in .mjs is not mirrored into the JSON (T-SWAP-06 tooling reading only JSON misses the context); (g) test subhead matcher allows 'body' which is dangerously broad (hero-body-bg would satisfy). OPTIONAL: (h) mockupPath hint in MW/MH assert; (i) grouping comments on hero-right text entries; (j) padEnd column tuning. Also SHOULD FIX for T-SWAP-05/06: BBOX coordinates are hand-tuned approximations — visual spot checks show navbar-logo, hero-video-frame, video-slot-1..4, hero-cta-primary all capture recognizable content, but nav-link Y may need +10 shift and hero-cta Y may need small nudge; precise pixel bounds are expected to be tuned again in T-SWAP-06 during home-hub.json wiring. Phase-G housekeeping note (carried from T-SWAP-01/02/03): scifi-mockup-v2/v3.png + generate-mockup-v2/v3.mjs still untracked in working tree — belong in Phase-G cleanup task (not this one).

tasks.title: Apply alpha-cutout (per-image threshold override for this palette)
tasks.notes: DONE. scripts/alpha-cutout.mjs — added CUTOUT_DIR / LOW_OVERRIDE / HIGH_OVERRIDE env-var overrides. Default target dir swapped from legacy base/ to the new canonical source-images/cropped/ (the per-node crops from extract-video.mjs). SKIP set now split: ALWAYS_SKIP={page-background} (opaque slate backdrop per CLAUDE.md §-IMAGE-TO-UI), LEGACY_BASE_SKIP={navbar-bg, hero-section-bg, feature-grid-section-bg, settings-section-bg, footer-bg, hero-card-bg} applied only when baseDir basename matches /base$/. Threshold parser (parseThreshold helper) rejects empty-string, non-finite, and out-of-range values instead of silently coercing — mirrors scifi-era discipline. Added deterministic sort() on readdirSync + split counters (skippedBackdrop vs skippedTiny) so log line distinguishes 'backdrop preserved' from 'tiny placeholder'. verify:prism 15/15, browser-smoke 6/6, T-SWAP-05 test OK. Spec-reviewer cycle: initial review (ba0ff11) flagged 1 MUST FIX — navbar-bg was in the unconditional SKIP set and would have been silently skipped under the new default cropped/ dir, leaving the AETHER nav-pill halo uncut. Resolved via split-set + baseDir basename gate; test fixture now writes a navbar-bg.png and asserts dark corners → alpha 0 (locks in that the new cropped/ default cuts the pill halo). Round-2 reviewer: 'no remaining MUST FIX.' SHOULD FIX carried forward for downstream: (a) isLegacyBaseDir regex fails on trailing-slash form (e.g. CUTOUT_DIR=.../base/) — path.basename() normalization is safer (today resolve() strips trailing slash for the default path, so only affects callers passing raw strings); (b) T-SWAP-06 downstream: home-hub.json node entries absent from the AETHER mockup need the TINY invisible-placeholder; alpha-cutout's 'tiny placeholder' width<3 guard already skips them, but extract-video.mjs does not yet emit them (TRANSPARENT_PNG branch unused). OPTIONAL: (c) localeCompare-based sort for mixed-case nodeId determinism; (d) log line could include legacy=${isLegacyBaseDir} so operator can tell which SKIP set applied from the log alone; (e) test could also run once with CUTOUT_DIR=.../base and positively assert navbar-bg preserved byte-for-byte (currently only tests the cropped/-side half of the contract). Phase-G housekeeping note (carried from T-SWAP-01..04): scifi-mockup-v2/v3.png + generate-mockup-v2/v3.mjs still untracked in working tree — belong in Phase-G cleanup task (not this one).

tasks.title: Patch home-hub.json: per-node transforms, hub.layout, strip stale fields
tasks.notes: DONE. scripts/patch-home-hub-for-mockup.mjs — surgical, idempotent, env-overridable (HOME_HUB_JSON / BBOX_JSON) migration that (a) sets hub.layout.viewportWidth=2816 + contentHeight=1536 from notes/mockup-candidates/ai-video-bbox-map.json (viewportHeight + backgroundColor preserved); (b) rewrites every node's visual.sourceAsset to literal 'cropped/<nodeId>.png'; (c) for 10 BBOX-matched nodeIds (page-background, navbar-bg, navbar-logo, navbar-link-pricing, footer-link-{privacy,terms,contact}, footer-social-{twitter,discord}, footer-copyright-text) sets transform.x/y/width/height from BBOX while preserving transform.z; (d) for the other 30 nodes sets transform={x:-1,y:-1,width:2,height:2,z:preserved} — the invisible-placeholder pattern from CLAUDE.md; (e) strips visual.regionKeys on every node except notifications-toggle (0 stripped today — already clean from Phase-F; code retained for idempotency). Output is deterministic 2-space JSON + LF trailing newline. verify:prism 15/15, browser-smoke 6/6, T-SWAP-06 test OK. Spec-reviewer: no MUST FIX. SHOULD FIX carried forward to T-SWAP-07/downstream: (a) build-atlas.mjs classifySource currently keys on base/ states/ overlays/ frames/ dirs and looks up node.visual.sourceAsset verbatim — 'cropped/<id>.png' literals need either a new cropped/ branch in classifySource OR build-atlas should strip the 'cropped/' prefix + '.png' suffix when building nodesByAsset (build-atlas.mjs:70 + build-prism.mjs:44 both read sourceAsset flatly); (b) 30 placeholder-node sourceAssets reference cropped/<id>.png files that do not exist on disk (only the 32 BBOX-keyed PNGs are in source-images/cropped/, 22 of those BBOX PNGs still unused by any node); consider a shared cropped/_placeholder.png (real 2×2 transparent PNG) matched by placeholders, matches CLAUDE.md wording more literally; T-SWAP-07 can either synthesize the 30 placeholder PNGs OR switch placeholder sourceAsset to a shared path; (c) intent.visualSpec.sourceAsset retained the bare-id form (e.g. 'page-background') while visual.sourceAsset moved to 'cropped/page-background.png' — asymmetry is harmless today (grep confirms no consumer reads intent.visualSpec.sourceAsset) but should be reconciled or documented; (d) theme-selector-button retains orphan defaultRegion='default' with no regionKeys — strip symmetrically when cleaning Phase-F state-variant fields; (e) acceptance test asserts transform.z is present+non-negative but not that it equals the pre-patch value — a regression that clobbered z to 0 would still pass; tighten with a pre-patch z snapshot or spot-check layers {0,40,49,50,51,100,101}; (f) acceptance test REQUIRED_NODE_FIELDS omits backendRef and visual.shape/overlayRegions/frameCount — a regression stripping visual.overlayRegions from hero-card-cta or navbar-signin-btn would pass today; tighten preservation assertions; (g) acceptance test could also assert the exact 10/30 matched/placeholder partition to lock the mockup↔graph mapping. OPTIONAL: (h) PLACEHOLDER literal {-1,-1,2,2} could share with TINY in extract-video.mjs via scripts/lib/placeholder.mjs; (i) writeFileSync UTF-8 encoding + LF lock-in for Windows autocrlf defense; (j) console.log leading tag to match sibling script style. Phase-G housekeeping note (carried from T-SWAP-01..05): scifi-mockup-v2/v3.png + generate-mockup-v2/v3.mjs still untracked in working tree — belong in Phase-G cleanup task (not this one).

tasks.title: Click-to-select: pointerdown on each node container emits node-selected event
tasks.notes: In boot.ts, for every node container registered, attach a pointerdown listener that fires window.__prism.events.emit('node-selected', { nodeId }). Add ALLOWED-GRAPHICS marker on any new hit-area if needed. Generic: no hardcoded nodeIds — iterate graph.nodes.

tasks.title: Inspector panel reads selected nodeId → shows intent.caption + transform + stateEffects
tasks.notes: src/components/editor/panels/Inspector.tsx subscribes to window.__prism.events.on('node-selected', ...). Reads graph.nodes.get(id) and renders intent.caption, transform.{x,y,z,scale}, stateEffects. Purely generic — no hardcoded nodeIds (anti-drift hook blocks them).

tasks.title: Inspector edits → mutate graph + re-apply on preview pane
tasks.notes: Inspector transform.x/y/z fields become controlled inputs. On change, write through to window.__prism.nodes.get(id).container position/scale AND mutate graph.nodes[id].transform. No persistence yet (T-ED-11 owns that).

tasks.title: SearchPalette ⌘K → fuzzy-search graph.nodes by nodeId + caption
tasks.notes: src/components/editor/SearchPalette.tsx binds ⌘K. Reads window.__prism.graph.nodes, fuzzy-matches input against nodeId + intent.caption. Selecting a result fires node-selected event — Inspector reacts automatically. Zero hardcoded IDs.

tasks.title: DetailCard shows sourceAsset preview + metadata for selected node
tasks.notes: src/components/editor/panels/DetailCard.tsx renders an of visual.sourceAsset (resolved from .prism/assets/) plus serviceTag, parentHubId, codeRef, backendRef. Generic — reads whatever the selected node has.

tasks.title: HubNav tabs route to hubs present in loaded .prism
tasks.notes: src/components/editor/HubNav.tsx reads manifest.hubs (array of hubIds). Renders a tab per hub; tabs for hubs not in the current manifest are disabled+greyed. Current .prism ships only home-hub, so Galaxy/Dashboard/etc. should render disabled.

tasks.title: Minimap renders actual graph.nodes count + active-node highlight
tasks.notes: src/components/editor/Minimap.tsx reads window.__prism.graph.nodes and draws a scaled-down rect per node using its transform. On node-selected, highlight the active rect. Reacts to currentBreakpoint changes.

tasks.title: Generic-editor audit: grep editor code for hardcoded mock-app node IDs
tasks.notes: Add a CI-style script scripts/audit-editor-genericity.mjs: greps src/components/editor/** for string literals matching the hardcoded-nodeId regex from anti-drift-check.sh. Zero matches required unless ALLOWED-HARDCODED-ID marker is present. Add to verify:prism as a 16th check.

tasks.title: Drag-on-preview: pointermove updates transform.x/y live
tasks.notes: Optional nice-to-have. Add a toggle in Inspector: 'Drag mode: off | on'. When on, pointerdown+move on a selected container updates container.position AND mirrors into graph.nodes[id].transform live. pointerup commits. No persistence (T-ED-11).

tasks.title: Save-to-home-hub.json: Inspector 'Save' button writes live transforms back
tasks.notes: Inspector 'Save' button calls a dev-only API route (src/app/api/save-graph/route.ts) that accepts { nodeId, transform } and writes back to src/lib/prism/mock-app-source/hubs/home-hub.json preserving deterministic JSON formatting (2-space, LF, trailing newline, key order).
